clips.title: The story
paras: Outside the Deepwater Tavern, First Mate Fitzsimmons drinks to drown his memories. He alone survived Kul Tiras's Third Fleet, burned off the Wetlands by red dragons enslaved by orcs during the Second War.

First Mate Fitzsimmons spends his days outside the Deepwater Tavern in Menethil Harbor, nursing a hangover and memories he cannot shake. He once served as an officer aboard the Wave Mistress, a ship-of-the-line that sailed under Kul Tiras's maritime banner. Now he trades those grim memories for dwarven mead. Anyone who buys him another drink can hear his account of one of the Second War's worst naval slaughters.

During the Second War, the Third Fleet sailed along the shores of Khaz Modan when fire came from the sky. The Dragonmaw clan had subdued the red dragonflight at Grim Batol and unleashed dragonfire on the unsuspecting warships. Fitzsimmons remembers helpless wooden hulls burning beneath towering flames, their crews dragged into the deep. He alone survived and washed ashore. His fallen brothers lie in the watery graveyard now known as the Doomed Fleet.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I was once First Mate on the Wave Mistress, ship-of-the-line in the Kul Tiras Third Fleet. The Doomed Fleet. Doomed, for on its last voyage the fleet was attacked by Red Dragons. Dragons controlled by Orcs!
We didn't stand a chance against that dragonfire...and our fleet was burned and sunk off this here coast. I'm the sole survivor of those poor vessels...
...Oh, my head hammers and pounds! I'll need a fresh drink if I'm to get a handle on this hangover and continue my tale.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Oh, I'm so very thirsty! Won't you buy a drink for this poor, pathetic fool?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah! That hits the spot, and loosens the tongue. Thanks, mate!
